notes: Three written גַּם morphemes take the three English connectives the ASV writes (*As well*, *as*, *and*): each member carries its own connective, so no one morpheme takes the pair (rule 14).
`כְּבָר` → *long ago* is headed on *ago*; *long* is the defensible alternative.
`וְ … אֵין` → *neither* fuses across the intervening `חֵלֶק` (rule 35), with *have* and *they* going to the possessive `לְ` and its suffix (rule 43).
